confirm_dfu: Are you sure? This will disconnect the controller and put it in Firmware Update mode.
group_pid_desc: PID (Proportional-Integral-Derivative) controller for precise wheel positioning and force feedback response.
msg_keyboard_warning: Keyboard mapping requires software running in background.
help_motion_range: Total rotation angle of the steering wheel (e.g., 900°).
help_total_effect_strength: Global Force Gain: Sets the overall maximum torque output.
help_static_dampening_strength: Static Damping: Constant resistance to movement (Heavy feel).
help_dynamic_dampening_strength: Dynamic Damping (Friction): Resistance increases with rotation speed.
help_integrated_spring_strength: Centering Spring: Returns wheel to center (for non-FFB games).
help_power_limit: Max current/power allowed for the motor.
help_braking_limit: Maximum braking force when motor acts as a brake.
help_pole_pairs: Number of magnetic pole pairs in your motor (Check motor spec).
help_amplifier_gain: Sensitivity adjustment for the motor driver.
help_proportional_gain: Proportional (P): Controls how aggressively the motor corrects position errors.
help_integral_gain: Integral (I): Accumulates past errors to correct steady-state drift.
help_ext_mode: Select the digital protocol for external peripherals.
protocol_desc_none: No external protocol. GPIOs are used for direct button inputs or disabled.
protocol_desc_buttons: Uses a Shift Register (74HC165) to expand button inputs.
protocol_desc_tm: Emulates Thrustmaster SPI protocol for compatible rims.
protocol_desc_fanatec: Emulates Fanatec SPI protocol for compatible rims.
protocol_config_buttons: Connect Data to MISO. Configure SPI pins.
protocol_tips_buttons: Chain multiple registers for more buttons.
protocol_config_tm: Use specific SPI timing. Check wiring.
help_calibration_speed: Speed at which the wheel rotates during auto-calibration.
help_min: Minimum ADC value for this axis (calibrate by moving to minimum position).
help_max: Maximum ADC value for this axis (calibrate by moving to maximum position).
help_button_mode: Configure how this button behaves (normal, inverted, or pulse mode).
help_pin_mode: Configure the function of this GPIO pin.
help_direct_x_constant_strength: Scale the strength of Constant Force effects from games.
help_direct_x_periodic_strength: Scale the strength of Periodic effects (Sine, Square, Triangle).
help_direct_x_spring_strength: Scale the strength of Spring effects requested by the game.
tools_warning_ffb: Warning: High forces can damage your hardware. Start with low values!
tools_dfu_description: Enter DFU mode to update the controller firmware. The device will disconnect and appear as a USB bootloader.
tools_warning_dfu: Warning: Only enter DFU mode if you have firmware ready to flash!
help_force_enabled: Globally enable or disable motor torque and force feedback.
help_encoder_direction: Invert the reading of the motor encoder. Use if the wheel position increases when it should decrease.
help_force_direction: Invert the direction of the force output. Use if the wheel pushes away from center instead of returning.
help_debug_torque: Send raw torque values to the logs for debugging purposes.
help_direct_x_constant_direction: Invert the direction of Constant Force effects coming from the game.
help_axis_invert: Invert the axis input (e.g., for inverted pedals).
